name: joy2know-lyricist
description: joy2know Lyric Designer: writes and revises lyrics that sing. One round of questions collects the brief (theme, point of view, genre, language, mood, avoid-list, use), then the genre picks the rhyme scheme and line shapes — seventeen genres each have their own conventions and there is no universal default, so the folk ballad, rap flow, blues AAB and Chinese-mode voices are handled differently. Hook-first writing (three candidate hooks before the chorus), a cliché blacklist (neon, broken, forever, tonight-as-rhyme, templated phrases) paired with a required-concrete-object list, and a rule that verse two must develop rather than twin verse one. Ships a read-only checker that makes six craft rules executable: section skeleton, cliché scan, line-length rhythm, hook presence, rhyme-versus-genre fit, and open-vowel chorus rhymes. Also fills in section tags and style-line suggestions. Text only — no audio is generated, no generative AI API is called, no account or key is carried; no copyright clearance or registration.

displayDescription.en: Turns a feeling into lyrics that sing: genre-accurate rhyme schemes, hook-first drafting, a cliché blacklist, and a six-rule structure check. Text only.
displayDescription.zh: 把感觉写成能唱的歌词：按体裁选押韵方案、先给钩子候选、避开陈词滥调，逐段结构检查。仅产出文本。

quickPrompts.en: My chorus is forgettable — give me three better hooks
quickPrompts.zh: 我的副歌记不住，给我三个更好的钩子
